Author: Guo Y, Tisoncik J, McReynolds S, Farzan M, Prabhakar BS, Gallagher T, Rong L, Caffrey M.
Comments: Mechanism: Presumably inhibit virus entry by binding to Spike protein, hACE2, or an unknown co-receptor.
Cytotoxicity: No cytotoxicity information found in the reference(s) presented
Hemolytic_activity: No hemolysis information or data found in the reference(s) presented in this entry
Name: SARS-CoV-S (215-232), peptide 9626
Target_Organism: [Ref.19853613]SARS-COV: inhibition of SARS-CoV/HIV PsV virus infection in 293T/ACE2 cells (IC50=11µM); inhibition of SARS-CoV/HIV PsV virus entry in 293T/ACE2 cells(80% at 50µM)
Title: Identification of a new region of SARS-CoV S protein critical for viral entry.
